faqs.question: What is Migratech Softwares?
faqs.answer: Migratech Softwares is a 360 Degree Digital Product Studio founded in 2017, based in Rudrapur, Uttarakhand, India. We provide sophisticated IT, software development, web & mobile app development, and digital marketing solutions worldwide.

faqs.question: What services does Migratech offer?
faqs.answer: We offer Web Development, Mobile App Development, Custom Software (CRM/ERP), Digital Marketing (SEO, SMO, PPC), Graphic Design & Branding, Domain Registration & Hosting, Attendance & Payroll Systems, Biometric & Access Control Systems, Ecommerce Solutions, and Software Testing.

faqs.question: What products does Migratech provide?
faqs.answer: Our key products include Interactive Flat Panels (IFPD), SmartClass educational technology platforms, and Biometric & Access Control systems.

faqs.question: How can I contact Migratech support or sales?
faqs.answer: You can reach us via phone at +91-8859907771 or +91-8171333362, or via email at migratech03@gmail.com.

faqs.question: What are your working hours?
faqs.answer: Our working hours are Monday through Saturday, from 10:00 AM to 06:00 PM. We are closed on Sundays.

faqs.question: Which industry domains does Migratech specialize in?
faqs.answer: We have strong expertise and solutions tailored for Educational, Healthcare, and Retail domains, among others.
